newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 18.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 20.02 points to 6,955.48, but investors remained worried that the Federal Reserve would boost interest rates next week.
* Telkom ADS in New York fell sharply to $30-1/4 on Monday from $32-1/4 on Friday. In London, Telkom fell to $29.5 on Monday from $32.46 on Friday. One ADS represents 20 ordinary shares.
Brokers said the falls were partly due to reports that the government may allow a privately-owned firm to compete directly against Telkom in providing basic telecommunications services.
* On Monday, the Jakarta composite index closed 4.09 points higher at 670.94 points.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,404.25/04.50 at 0135 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,404.00/05.00
* Prasidha as the commodity trading firm expected to record net profits of 40 billion rupiah in 1997 against 30.7 billion rupiah in 1996.
* Telkom following sharp falls in London and on Wall Street overnight.
* Transportation firm Mitra Rajasa on market talk that business tycoon Yopie Widjaja planned to acquire the firm. Widjadja has denied the rumour.
* Barito Pacific on reports its unit PT Tanjung Enim Lestari Pulp and Paper signed a $991 million loan agreement with 25 foreign banks on Friday to set up a new pulp mill.
* Cigarette maker Sampoerna and noodle maker Indofood on reports that Sampoerna's president director Putra Sampoerna planned to take a 15-percent stake in Indofood.
Also Indofood on reports its net profit rose to 351.31 billion rupiah in 1996 from 305.37 billion rupiah in 1995.
